tools.name: verify_artifact
tools.description: Verify an artifact produced by an AI agent before accepting or paying for it. Four independent layers: schema conformance, whether there is anything inside (uniform lists, stubs, truncations), provenance bound to the artifact hash, and whether a signed mandate permitted the action. Returns a verdict

tools.name: verify_artifact_batch
tools.description: Verify several artifacts at once — a scan report, a list of findings, a set of tool descriptions. One call, one verdict per artifact, plus a summary of how many were accepted, need review, or were rejected. Use when an agent produced a batch (twenty findings from a security scan, for example) and ea
